avis.titre: Two step peel....made my skin act right

Very rare behavior these days. I chose to use these at night, because retinol and peel pads feel like nighttime business, not "let me slap this on and go battle the sun" business. After only using them for about two to three days, I could already feel a difference. My skin felt softer the next morning, and it even looked a little more plump and refreshed, which was honestly impressive for such a short amount of time. I liked that it's a two-step peel because it made the whole thing feel a little more serious, like I was doing skincare and not just panic-swiping something on my face at midnight. Since it has retinol and peel energy going on, I definitely wouldn't use it like a maniac, especially if your skin is sensitive or dramatic. Overall, I really liked this so far. It's the kind of treatment I'd keep using when my skin looks tired, textured, or like it has been personally victimized by stress, weather, and bad decisions.
